card.name: CTCAE version number and data cutoff
card.fires_on: The point in "version 5.0" of the NCI CTCAE citation, and the word "data" in "data cutoff" or "data cut-off". Also the break before a revision date.

card.plain: It marks fixed phrases in drug labels, like the CTCAE version number and the trial data cutoff.
